topPRs.title: validation: update standard proof params for Upgrade 20 game types
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
## Description

Updates `standard-config-params-mainnet.toml` and `standard-config-params-sepolia.toml` so the standard proof parameters reflect [Upgrade 20](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/releases/tag/op-contracts%2Fv8.0.0-rc.3) (`op-contracts/v8.0.0`), which moves standard chains from Output Root to Super Root dispute games:

- `respected_game_type`: `0` (`CANNON`) → `9` (`SUPER_CANNON_KONA`). Permissioned chains use `5` (`SUPER_PERMISSIONED`).
- `[proofs.permissioned].game_type`: `1` (`PERMISSIONED_CANNON`) → `5` (`SUPER_PERMISSIONED`). The depth/clock parameters are dropped from this section: `SuperPermissionedDisputeGame` v1.1.0 is not a bisection game (no `maxGameDepth()` / `splitDepth()` / `maxClockDuration()` / `clockExtension()` getters) and resolves immediately as `DEFENDER_WINS`, subject to the air-gap.
- New `[proofs.permissionless]` section for `SUPER_CANNON_KONA` (`9`) carrying the existing standard FDG parameters (`max_game_depth = 73`, `split_depth = 30`, `max_clock_duration = 302400`, `clock_extension = 10800`, matching op-deployer's standard defaults). The `ProofsParams` struct in `validation/params.go` already has a `permissionless` field, so no Go changes are needed.

Both `respected_game_type` and the permissioned `game_type` had been stale since Upgrade 19 (chains were already on `CANNON_KONA` 8, not `CANNON` 0). Codegen already classifies 5 as permissioned and 9 as permissionless since #1290.

`ops/internal/report/testdata/expected-comment.md` is updated to match: the fixture is an `op-contracts/v1.6.0` deployment on game type 1, which no longer matches the standard, so the "Permissioned Proofs" rows now render as warnings.

These files are the governance-approved source of truth for the [Standard Rollup Charter](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/OPerating-manual/blob/main/Standard%20Rollup%20Charter.md) configuration check; the charter update re-pinning to this branch is ethereum-optimism/OPerating-manual#71.

## Follow-ups (out of scope for this TOML change)

- `ops/internal/report/l1.go` (`ScanFDG`) hardcodes game type `1` and reads bisection getters from the permissioned game, and `comment.md.tmpl` only renders the permissioned section. Both need updating before the staging report can validate a v8 deployment.
- `standard-config-roles-*.toml` still lists `protocolVersionsOwner` although `ProtocolVersions` is removed in v8. Left unchanged here because `ops/internal/deployer/state.go` still writes it into op-deployer intents for older intent versions.
